_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P0 operational targets.

requirements.title: Append-only journal
requirements.description: The ledger shall append every accepted entry and reject updates or deletes to journal rows.

validation.notes: Append-only migration guard rejects journal updates and deletes.

requirements.title: Scope-isolated recall
requirements.description: When a client supplies a scope, the ledger shall return only entries and derived nodes from that scope.

validation.notes: Recall source enforces explicit scope isolation and the agent-memory default.

requirements.title: Bounded compaction canopy
requirements.description: When compaction runs, the ledger shall preserve journal rows and maintain a scored frontier with rebuildable summaries and edges.

validation.notes: Compaction repeats until the eligible frontier target is reached and rebuild remains inference-independent.

requirements.title: Stable programmatic surface
requirements.description: The ledger shall expose scope-aware Connect, API, and CLI operations for append, recall, wake, frontier, and health.

validation.notes: Health and generated Connect/API surfaces are covered by the owned handler and journal integration tests.

requirements.title: Durable corpus authority
requirements.description: The ledger shall keep one authoritative SQLite corpus with registered backup and restore evidence.

validation.notes: Registered SQLite target was backed up, verified, audited for integrity, restored to a temporary file, and compared read-only: 6089 entries and 8 scopes matched.

requirements.title: Team corpus adoption contract
requirements.description: When a team adopts the ledger, the service shall register or reuse one named scope, append prose entries with provenance, return a bounded wake block within the scope wake budget, and support scoped semantic recall without introducing a second team-memory vocabulary.

validation.ref: source-ledger scopes list --json; source-ledger recall wake --scope team:marketing-crew --json; source-ledger recall recall --scope team:marketing-crew
validation.notes: Live governed CLI/API surfaces are scope-explicit and return bounded wake plus scoped recall; the operator policy and consumer signal were also exercised.

requirements.title: Team scope registration
requirements.description: A team member can register or idempotently reuse one named scope with its facet vocabulary, frontier target, maximum entry lines, and wake budget.

validation.ref: source-ledger scopes list --json; source-ledger policy show --scope team:marketing-crew --json
validation.notes: Live scope inventory and effective policy readback verify the named scope and its persisted budgets without a second local configuration path.

requirements.title: Scoped prose append
requirements.description: A team member can append a prose journal entry to a named scope with verified provenance without updating or deleting an existing journal row.

validation.notes: Scoped journal append/get/list integration preserves the append-only source boundary and provenance shape.

requirements.title: Bounded scoped wake
requirements.description: A team member can render a bounded wake block for a named scope, and scope creation rejects a wake budget that cannot hold the configured frontier target at maximum entry size.

validation.notes: Wake applies dual ceilings and typed budget validation while preserving scope identity.

requirements.title: Scoped semantic recall
requirements.description: A team member can perform semantic recall within an explicitly named scope, without implicitly reading another team's corpus.

validation.notes: Scoped semantic recall excludes entries from other scopes and defaults safely to agent-memory.
